_help: The runners to choose from. body: male or female; skin: light or dark (tint shades it: 1 as it comes, lower is deeper); hair: a file in models/people (without .gltf); beard: true or false; top and legs: their kit's colours (a suit from the shop replaces the top). Compared with an all-rounder at 1: 'agility' (how fast they change lanes), 'spring' (how high they jump), 'grit' (how little a stumble costs: shorter slowdown, the drone gives up sooner) and 'reach' (how far to the side they pick up coins; 2.2 reaches into the next lane).

runners.name: Rio
runners.about: The all-rounder. Nothing to learn, nothing to make up for.

runners.name: Kemi
runners.about: Springs off the roof: the highest jump of anyone. A bit slow across.

runners.name: Dash
runners.about: Quick feet: changes lanes in a flash. Doesn't get much air.

runners.name: Tunde
runners.about: Tough: a stumble barely slows him and the drone gives up sooner. Heavy on his feet.

runners.name: Ava
runners.about: Long reach: grabs coins from the next lane over. Rattled by a stumble.

runners.name: Zara
runners.about: Light and nimble: quick across and a good jump. A stumble costs her most.
